SEARCH
Package com.splendor.view

Interface IGameView

All Known Implementing Classes:
ConsoleView, NetworkGameView, RemoteView
public interface IGameView
Contract for all view implementations in the Splendor game's MVC architecture. This interface defines the complete set of operations required to render the game state and collect user input. It supports multiple implementation strategies:
  • ConsoleView - Local terminal-based console interface
  • RemoteView - Network client view for remote players
  • NetworkGameView - Server-side view that routes to multiple clients

The view layer is responsible for:

  • Rendering the game board, player states, and available actions
  • Prompting users for input and validating basic format
  • Displaying messages, errors, and notifications
  • Managing the user interaction flow during each turn

All view implementations must be stateless with respect to game logic; they should only handle presentation and input collection. The controller layer (GameController) is responsible for interpreting input and updating the model.

Typical turn flow:

  1. displayGameState(Game) - Show current board state
  2. promptForMove(Player, Game, List) - Collect player's action choice
  3. displayNotification(String) - Show result of action
See Also:
  • For the controller that uses this view
  • Default console implementation
